en.title: South Korea's Yun Kyu-sung wins gold in taekwondo poomsae at Asian Games
en.summary: South Korean athlete Yun Kyu-sung claimed the gold medal in men's individual taekwondo poomsae at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, scoring 9.3800 points. This represents South Korea's second gold medal in the taekwondo poomsae event at the games.
